projectName: Azure Cloud Monitoring & Cost Intelligence Platform
summary: Production-oriented Azure cloud monitoring and cost intelligence platform with a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, SQLAlchemy persistence, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, Azure subscription connection, dashboards, monitoring modules, and Azure integration scaffolding.

questions.question: Which language should the web frontend use?
questions.rationale: TypeScript is a strong default for a production Next.js application and the request specifies Next.js.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for the Next.js application.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: Next.js is explicitly required; App Router is the production-oriented default.

options.label: Next.js (App Router)
options.description: Next.js with the modern App Router and React.

options.label: Next.js (Pages Router)
options.description: Next.js using the legacy Pages Router.

questions.question: What should the frontend include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive cloud operations dashboard; subscription onboarding and connection status; cost and usage insights; monitoring, alerts, and resource views; accessible navigation and loading, empty, and error states.
questions.answer: Responsive cloud operations dashboard; subscription onboarding and connection status; cost and usage insights; monitoring, alerts, and resource views; accessible navigation and loading, empty, and error states.
questions.rationale: Derived from the requested dashboard, monitoring modules, cost intelligence, and subscription connection flow.

questions.question: Which language should the API backend use?
questions.rationale: The request specifies FastAPI, which is a Python framework.

questions.question: Which backend framework should be used?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: Async-capable Python API framework with OpenAPI support.

questions.question: What should the backend include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Versioned REST APIs; SQLAlchemy persistence and migrations; Entra ID token validation and authorization; secure Azure subscription connection and read-only inventory/monitoring/cost integration scaffolding; dashboard and alert APIs; health checks, audit events, and background data-refresh boundaries.
questions.answer: Versioned REST APIs; SQLAlchemy persistence and migrations; Entra ID token validation and authorization; secure Azure subscription connection and read-only inventory/monitoring/cost integration scaffolding; dashboard and alert APIs; health checks, audit events, and background data-refresh boundaries.
questions.rationale: Captures the requested API, database, identity, onboarding, dashboard, monitoring, and Azure integration scope while keeping Azure access least-privileged by default.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
recommendedChoice: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
answer: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
questions.rationale: A relational database is needed for connected subscription metadata, user/workspace configuration, monitoring and cost snapshots, and alert state; PostgreSQL works well with SQLAlchemy.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The application does not persist application data.

options.label: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
options.description: Managed relational database for application and collected metadata.

options.label: Azure SQL Database
options.description: Managed relational database using SQL Server.

options.label: Azure Cache for Redis
options.description: Managed cache for transient data and distributed coordination.

options.label: Azure Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for files and unstructured data.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application API features?
questions.rationale: The request explicitly requires Entra ID authentication and a subscription connection flow.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate before accessing application features.

options.label: No
options.description: Application API features are available without user sign-in.
